slice: RPP-5ll selected append from a five-element consumed MLINESTYLE
scope: Adds source-bound AC1027 evidence for appending one tuple to a consumed five-element MLINESTYLE, producing six elements. The generic consumed-style append transaction is unchanged; this receipt qualifies the selected five-to-six source-count profile only. It does not claim every source-count combination, other geometry or native semantic support.

references.use: Group 73 is the MLINESTYLE element count; group 74 gives repeated per-vertex parameter counts; group 41 carries the parameters and group 75/42 carry area-fill counts and values.
Group 49 carries MLINESTYLE element offsets. The selected projection remains limited to the admitted flag and angle profile.

contract.admission: The authored original source has five MLINESTYLE elements with offsets [1.25,-0.75,-1.25,-2.0,-2.5], ACI [1,3,4,5,6] and linetypes [ByLayer,Continuous,ByLayer,Continuous,ByLayer]. It is consumed by two source-bound ordinary MLINEs. The target appends exactly one tuple (-3.0, ACI 7, Continuous), yielding six elements. Source and target flags are 2 with equal angles. Original style, dictionary/provider graph and consumers stay bound; both consumers remain open, uncut and unfilled.
contract.geometry: The generated source begins with an authored four-element AC1027 profile, adds a fifth style tuple, and recalculates each source consumer's five group-41 parameter pairs per vertex against source minimum -2.5. The transaction appends one tuple and recomputes all six per-vertex parameter pairs against target minimum -3.0. Consumers have three vertices, positive finite scale, center/bottom justification, unit extrusion and source-consistent positions, directions and miters. Every pair has zero second value; group 42 is absent and group-75 counts are zero.
contract.identityAndOutput: The MLINESTYLE retains its source name and emits group 71 = 6, all six group-49 offsets, the style flag color plus six element ACI values, and six element linetype names. Unique ByLayer and Continuous LTYPE providers are checked under the LTYPE TABLE with their handles and owners. Both MLINE consumers retain their source names and group 340 to the emitted style handle; each has group 73 = 6, eighteen group-74 values of 2, thirty-six group-41 values, eighteen zero group-75 values and no group 42. Fresh import checks style tuples, consumer counts, arrays, geometry vectors, scale and extrusion for model-space and named-block consumers.
contract.failureAndRetry: An unsupported style flag refuses before publication and preserves the destination and caller snapshot; correcting the flag permits same-adapter retry. A late mutation of a live consumer parameter refuses before publication; restoring the captured caller snapshot permits same-adapter retry. Both failure classes are exercised with ASCII and binary output. Successful profiles cross ASCII/binary source and ASCII/binary output.
contract.compatibility: No public API or DRW_Interface virtual changes. All input/output drawings are authored at runtime from scratch and removed after success; no drawing fixtures are committed.
contract.limits: This receipt covers AC1027 source count 5 to target count 6, with the exact generated tuples, flags, angles and two open, uncut, unfilled consumers. It does not qualify other source counts, multi-element append from a five-element source, removals, composed edits, other MLINE schemas/carriers/versions, native CAD rendering, document closure or independent 3D semantics. No support claim is promoted.

controls.tupleAndProjection: The target offsets are [1.25,-0.75,-1.25,-2.0,-2.5,-3.0], colors [1,3,4,5,6,7], linetypes [ByLayer,Continuous,ByLayer,Continuous,ByLayer,Continuous]. The source recipe recomputes five-element source parameters against minimum -2.5; output parameters are checked against target minimum -3.0.
controls.failureAndRetry: Four successful source/output profiles and eight successful readbacks total; two invalid-flag refusals and two late-consumer mutation refusals; corrected same-adapter retries succeed in both output encodings. No external fixture is stored.
